releaseTitle: ATalk v3.17.1 — Chronological Message Sync & Input Reliability Fix
releaseNotes:
• 01 Chronological Order & Insertion Integrity: Fixed out-of-order display where delayed incoming or server-synced messages were appended at the bottom instead of ordered strictly by creation epoch timestamp.
• 02 Viewport Position Preservation: Eliminated list clearing during message reordering, ensuring LazyColumn scroll position remains stable and never resets to months-old messages.
• 03 Real-Time Keyboard Input Synchronization: Fixed state sync between TextFieldState and Compose text observers, ensuring send buttons activate immediately upon typing and sent messages transmit cleanly.
• 04 Optimistic Chronological Insertion: Outgoing messages now insert immediately at their correct chronological timestamp position with smooth auto-scroll to the bottom.
